> **Pipeline step 05 — main-text ensemble figures (stacked-model effects).**
>
> **Purpose.** Builds the stacking-weighted ensemble figures: combined TPS + EDSM catch
> conditional effects (original units), the TPS/EDSM "butterfly" coefficient forest (alt4,
> annotated; alt5, clean), and the fork-length coefficient forest (alt90) and conditional effects.
>
> **How it stays fast.** A guarded chunk (`build-or-load-cache`) streams every fit once
> (load → extract the posterior `b_*` draws, the predictive criterion and the ensemble
> conditional-effects grid → free) into `cache/fast_figure_cache_kfold.rds`. After that every
> render reads only the cache (~1 min). Set `force_rebuild <- TRUE` in `setup` after refitting.
>
> **Inputs.** fits from steps 01–03 (cache build only); model CSVs for back-transforming z-scores.
> **Outputs.** `output_figs/combined_TPS_EDSM_*`, `output_figs/TPS_FL_*` (PDF vector + 600 dpi
> LZW TIFF + PNG preview).
>
> The salinity-included appendix versions are produced by
> `appendix_salinity_temperature_wateryear/A07_salinity_ensemble_figures.R`, which re-uses the
> function chunks defined here.

```{r project-root, include=FALSE}
# Every path in this notebook (data/, fits_*/, output_figs/, cache/) is relative to the
# REPOSITORY ROOT, not to this file's sub-folder. Walk up from the working directory to the
# folder holding the .Rproj file, and make knitr (and RStudio's chunk-by-chunk notebook
# mode) run every chunk from there. Base R only -- no extra package needed.
find_repo_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  p <- normalizePath(path)
  while (!length(list.files(p, pattern = "\\.Rproj$"))) {
    if (dirname(p) == p) stop("No .Rproj file found above ", path)
    p <- dirname(p)
  }
  p
}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = find_repo_root())
```
Streamlined, cache-backed version of the project's full ensemble notebook (not needed here). It produces ONLY
five figures and never re-reads whole brms fits on a normal render.

A one-time guarded chunk streams every fit **one at a time** (load → extract the
small pieces → free), and saves the small bits each figure needs to
`cache/fast_figure_cache_kfold.rds`:

  • per-fit `b_*` posterior draws + predictive criteria (for the butterfly and
    fork-length forest figures);
  • the precomputed ensemble conditional-effects data (the only fit-touching figure
    step) for the catch and fork-length conditional-effects figures.

After the cache exists, every render reads it and runs in seconds — no fit is ever
loaded. Set `force_rebuild <- TRUE` to refresh after refitting models or after
changing which covariates are plotted (the cached CE is tied to the selected set).

Figures produced:
  1. Catch conditional effects, original-scale x (combined TPS + EDSM, cms / units)
  2. Butterfly forest ALT4 (one-column, journal-sized; weight-shaded slabs + annotations)
  3. Butterfly forest ALT5 (annotation-free clean variant; taller curves, black median hashes)
  4. Fork-length beta forest (centered + right label layouts)
  5. Fork-length conditional effects, original-scale x (freed water-year-day y-axis)

```{r setup}
library(brms)
library(loo)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)      # tribble()
library(posterior)
library(ggdist)
library(marquee)     # element_marquee(): renders **bold** in axis labels.
# NOTE: ggtext::element_markdown() does NOT work here — ggplot2 4.x moved theme elements
# to S7 and ggtext 0.1.2's element is silently ignored (tags print literally).  marquee
# only works when the theme's ROOT text element is marquee-ised too, hence
# marquefy_theme(theme_minimal(...)) in the figure functions below.

# TRUE = re-stream all fits and rebuild the cache (~20 min). FALSE = fast render
# from the saved cache.
force_rebuild <- FALSE
cache_path    <- "cache/fast_figure_cache_kfold.rds"
```

```{r fit-registry}
# EDSM catch: 22 station-intercept k-fold models, referenced by path; kfold criteria
# are pre-bundled (tiny, no fits touched).

fit_names_edsm_catch <- paste0("fit_edsm_catch", edsm_nums)

edsm_criteria     <- setNames(edsm_kfold_bundle[paste0("fit_edsm_", edsm_nums)],
                              fit_names_edsm_catch)
stopifnot(!any(vapply(edsm_criteria, is.null, logical(1))))

# TPS catch: 14 models (path-only; streamed during the cache build, not pre-loaded).

# Combined registry for streaming consumers (covers both catch surveys).
```

HELPER FUNCTIONS (verbatim from source notebook)
```{r helpers}
get_criterion <- function(f) {
  if (!is.null(f$criteria$loo)) return(f$criteria$loo)          # psis-loo (TPS)
  hits <- Filter(function(x) inherits(x, "kfold"), f$criteria)  # kfold5_StationCode (EDSM)
  if (length(hits) > 0L) hits[[1L]] else loo(f)
}


get_elpd <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "psis_loo")) x$pointwise[, "elpd_loo"]
  else                          x$pointwise[, "elpd_kfold"]
}


stacking_weights_streamed <- function(fit_names,
                                      fit_paths,
                                      criteria = NULL,
                                      method   = "stacking") {
  crit_list <- vector("list", length(fit_names))
  names(crit_list) <- fit_names
  for (nm in fit_names) {
    if (!is.null(criteria) && nm %in% names(criteria)) {
      crit_list[[nm]] <- criteria[[nm]]
    } else {
      f <- readRDS(fit_paths[[nm]])
      crit_list[[nm]] <- get_criterion(f)
      rm(f); gc(verbose = FALSE)
    }
  }
  all_psis <- all(vapply(crit_list, function(x) inherits(x, "psis_loo"), logical(1)))
  w <- if (all_psis) {
    loo::loo_model_weights(crit_list, method = method)
  } else {
    lpd_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(crit_list, get_elpd))
    if (method == "pseudobma") loo::pseudobma_weights(lpd_mat)
    else                       loo::stacking_weights(lpd_mat)
  }
  w <- as.numeric(w); names(w) <- fit_names
  w
}


epred_marginal_lognormal <- function(object, newdata, re_formula = NA,
                                     sd_par = "sd_StationCode__Intercept", ...) {
  if (!isTRUE(is.na(re_formula))) {
    stop("epred_marginal_lognormal() requires re_formula = NA (the correction assumes RE = 0).")
  }
  ep <- posterior_epred(object, newdata = newdata, re_formula = NA, ...)       # S x G = exp(Xbeta)
  sd_draws <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(posterior::as_draws_matrix(object, variable = sd_par)),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(sd_draws)) return(ep)   # no random intercept in this model -- no correction needed
  sweep(ep, 1, exp(sd_draws^2 / 2), `*`)                                       # exp(Xbeta) * exp(sigma^2/2)
}


get_effect_option <- function(option, effect_name) {
  if (is.null(option)) return(NULL)
  if (is.list(option) && !is.null(option[[effect_name]])) {
    return(option[[effect_name]])
  }
  if (!is.list(option) && !is.null(names(option)) && effect_name %in% names(option)) {
    return(unname(option[[effect_name]]))
  }
  if (!is.list(option) && !is.null(names(option))) {
    option_names_norm <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(names(option))
    effect_name_norm <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(effect_name)
    idx <- which(option_names_norm == effect_name_norm)
    if (length(idx) > 0L) {
      return(unname(option[[idx[1]]]))
    }
  }
  option
}


normalize_effect_interaction_names <- function(effects) {
  out <- sub("^b_", "", as.character(effects))
  is_interaction <- grepl(":", out, fixed = TRUE)
  if (any(is_interaction)) {
    parts <- strsplit(out[is_interaction], ":", fixed = TRUE)
    out[is_interaction] <- vapply(parts, function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = ":"), character(1))
  }
  out
}


# Centre the LINES inside a multi-line marquee label.
# marquee 1.2.1 always left-aligns the lines within a text block: its style `align`
# and the element's `hjust` only move the whole block, not the lines inside it
# (verified by pixel-identical renders across align/hjust settings).  So we centre
# by padding the shorter lines with NON-BREAKING spaces, sized from real font
# metrics; NBSP is used because markdown collapses ordinary leading spaces.
# Call BEFORE converting "\n" into markdown hard breaks ("  \n").
center_md_lines <- function(txt, family = "Helvetica", size = 8.5) {
  is_bold <- function(x) grepl("^[[:space:]]*[*][*].*[*][*][[:space:]]*$", x)
  nbsp <- "\u00A0"
  out <- vapply(txt, function(s) {
    ln <- strsplit(s, "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(ln) < 2) return(s)
    plain <- gsub("**", "", ln, fixed = TRUE)
    bold  <- is_bold(ln)
    w <- vapply(seq_along(plain), function(i)
      systemfonts::string_width(plain[i], family = family, size = size,
                                weight = if (bold[i]) "bold" else "normal"),
      numeric(1))
    sw  <- systemfonts::string_width(nbsp, family = family, size = size)
    pad <- pmax(0, round((max(w) - w) / (2 * sw)))
    paste(paste0(strrep(nbsp, pad), ln), collapse = "\n")
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  names(out) <- names(txt)
  out
}

map_parameter_labels <- function(params, param_labels = NULL, lookup_keys = NULL) {
  out <- as.character(params)
  keys <- if (is.null(lookup_keys)) out else as.character(lookup_keys)
  if (is.null(param_labels)) return(out)
  
  if (is.function(param_labels)) {
    return(as.character(param_labels(keys)))
  }
  
  if (is.list(param_labels)) {
    param_labels <- unlist(param_labels)
  }
  
  if (is.null(names(param_labels))) {
    return(out)
  }
  
  idx <- match(keys, names(param_labels))
  out[!is.na(idx)] <- as.character(param_labels[idx[!is.na(idx)]])
  out
}


normalize_beta_interaction_param <- function(params) {
  p <- as.character(params)
  out <- p
  is_interaction <- grepl("^b_[^:]+:.+", p)
  
  if (any(is_interaction)) {
    raw <- sub("^b_", "", p[is_interaction])
    parts <- strsplit(raw, ":", fixed = TRUE)
    norm <- vapply(parts, function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = ":"), character(1))
    out[is_interaction] <- paste0("b_", norm)
  }
  
  out
}


plot_ce_effect <- function(effect_data,
                           effect_name,
                           x_axis_labels        = NULL,
                           y_axis_label         = "Predicted effect on response",
                           legend_title         = NULL,
                           legend_labels        = NULL,
                           show_facet_subtitle  = TRUE,
                           y_limits             = NULL,
                           legend_position      = "right",
                           interaction_colors   = NULL) {
  panel_title <- if (isTRUE(show_facet_subtitle)) effect_name else NULL
  x_label <- get_effect_option(x_axis_labels, effect_name)
  if (is.null(x_label)) {
    x_label <- if (is.factor(effect_data$effect1__)) "Category" else "Predictor value (Z-score)"
  }
  
  if (is.factor(effect_data$effect1__)) {
    # Categorical main effect
    p <- ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = effect1__, y = estimate__)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), width = 0.2) +
      labs(
        title = panel_title,
        x = x_label,
        y = y_axis_label
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
  } else if ("effect2__" %in% names(effect_data)) {
    # Interaction effect
    effect_data$effect2_factor <- factor(effect_data$effect2__)
    legend_title_eff <- get_effect_option(legend_title, effect_name)
    if (is.null(legend_title_eff)) {
      legend_title_eff <- effect_name
    }
    
    legend_labels_eff <- get_effect_option(legend_labels, effect_name)
    legend_breaks <- levels(effect_data$effect2_factor)
    if (is.function(legend_labels_eff)) {
      legend_labels_eff <- legend_labels_eff(legend_breaks)
    } else if (!is.null(legend_labels_eff) && !is.null(names(legend_labels_eff))) {
      mapped <- as.character(legend_breaks)
      idx <- match(legend_breaks, names(legend_labels_eff))
      mapped[!is.na(idx)] <- as.character(legend_labels_eff[idx[!is.na(idx)]])
      legend_labels_eff <- mapped
    }
    
    # Choose colorblind-safe manual scales when colors are supplied; otherwise
    # fall back to the ggplot2 default discrete palette.
    c_scale <- if (!is.null(interaction_colors)) {
      scale_color_manual(values = interaction_colors, name = legend_title_eff,
                         breaks = legend_breaks, labels = legend_labels_eff)
    } else {
      scale_color_discrete(name = legend_title_eff,
                           breaks = legend_breaks, labels = legend_labels_eff)
    }
    f_scale <- if (!is.null(interaction_colors)) {
      scale_fill_manual(values = interaction_colors, name = legend_title_eff,
                        breaks = legend_breaks, labels = legend_labels_eff)
    } else {
      scale_fill_discrete(name = legend_title_eff,
                          breaks = legend_breaks, labels = legend_labels_eff)
    }

    p <- ggplot(effect_data,
           aes(x = effect1__, y = estimate__, color = effect2_factor, fill = effect2_factor)) +
      geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__),
        alpha = 0.2
      ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      labs(
        title = panel_title,
        x = x_label,
        y = y_axis_label
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      c_scale +
      f_scale +
      theme(legend.position = legend_position)
    
  } else {
    # Continuous main effect
    p <- ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = effect1__, y = estimate__)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
      labs(
        title = panel_title,
        x = x_label,
        y = y_axis_label
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
  }
  
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
  }
  p
}


plot_ce_effect_fl <- function(effect_data, effect_name,
                              x_axis_labels       = NULL,
                              y_axis_label        = "Predicted ForkLength (mm)",
                              show_facet_subtitle = TRUE,
                              y_limits            = NULL,
                              ce_color            = "#0072B2",
                              z_stats             = NULL) {
  panel_title <- if (isTRUE(show_facet_subtitle)) effect_name else NULL
  x_label <- get_effect_option(x_axis_labels, effect_name)
  if (is.null(x_label)) {
    x_label <- if (is.factor(effect_data$effect1__)) "Category" else "Predictor value (z-score)"
  }

  if (is.factor(effect_data$effect1__)) {
    p <- ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = effect1__, y = estimate__)) +
      geom_point(size = 2, color = ce_color) +
      geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), width = 0.2, color = ce_color) +
      labs(title = panel_title, x = x_label, y = y_axis_label) +
      theme_minimal()
  } else {
    p <- ggplot(effect_data, aes(x = effect1__, y = estimate__)) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.25, fill = ce_color) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = ce_color) +
      labs(title = panel_title, x = x_label, y = y_axis_label) +
      theme_minimal()
  }
  # Original-scale x-axis (optional): relabel the z-position ticks with their
  # back-transformed original-unit values.  Only for continuous effects; categorical
  # panels (e.g. Edge Type) have no z_stats entry and are left untouched.
  eff_stats <- if (!is.null(z_stats)) z_stats[[effect_name]] else NULL
  if (!is.null(eff_stats) && !is.factor(effect_data$effect1__)) {
    p <- p + scale_x_continuous(
      labels = function(z_val) {
        orig <- z_val * eff_stats$sd + eff_stats$mean
        format(round(orig, eff_stats$digits), big.mark = ",", nsmall = max(0L, eff_stats$digits))
      }
    )
  }
  # Angle x-tick labels so long factor levels (e.g. Edge Type) don't overlap.
  p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))
  if (!is.null(y_limits)) p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits)
  p
}


```

STREAMING COMPUTE + SINGLE-PASS EXTRACTOR
```{r compute-funcs}
# SINGLE streaming pass per fit: load once, grab its b_* posterior draws AND its
# predictive criterion (psis-loo for TPS, kfold for EDSM/FL), then free it before
# moving on.  Never holds more than one fit in memory — the whole 2.7 GB set is
# never resident.  Replaces the source notebook's bulk load_fit_objects() +
# separate draws/criteria passes.
extract_beta_and_criterion <- function(fit_names, fit_paths) {
  draws <- vector("list", length(fit_names)); names(draws) <- fit_names
  crit  <- vector("list", length(fit_names)); names(crit)  <- fit_names
  for (nm in fit_names) {
    f  <- readRDS(fit_paths[[nm]])
    df <- posterior::as_draws_df(f)
    bcols <- grep("^b_", names(df), value = TRUE)
    draws[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(df)[, bcols, drop = FALSE]
    crit[[nm]]  <- get_criterion(f)
    rm(f, df); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }
  list(draws = draws, criteria = crit)
}


# Generic STREAMING ensemble conditional-effects compute for ONE survey.
# Loads each fit one at a time — Pass A captures one reference grid per requested
# effect (stops once all grids are captured); Pass B reloads each non-zero-weight
# fit, predicts on every grid, accumulates weight * draws, and frees the fit — so
# peak memory is ~one fit, never the whole set.  `epred_fn` picks the response-scale
# predictor:
#   catch        -> epred_marginal_lognormal (lognormal RE correction)
#   fork length  -> posterior_epred          (gaussian / identity; no correction)
# Returns list(ce = <named CE data frames>, pred_names).  This is the cached unit:
# everything downstream is pure layout and touches no fit.
compute_survey_ce <- function(fit_names, fit_paths, selected_params, criteria,
                              method = "stacking", resolution = 100,
                              re_formula = NA, probs = c(0.05, 0.95),
                              epred_fn = epred_marginal_lognormal) {
  summ_cols <- c("estimate__", "lower__", "upper__", "se__")

  build_model_newdata <- function(model, newdata_ref) {
    needed <- all.vars(model$formula$formula[[3]])
    nd  <- newdata_ref
    dat <- model$data
    for (v in setdiff(needed, names(nd))) {
      if (!v %in% names(dat)) next
      col <- dat[[v]]
      # Categoricals are held at the model's REFERENCE level (not the modal level),
      # so every conditional-effects panel conditions on the same baseline that the
      # brms reference grid uses in Pass A — one rule, statable in a caption:
      # "continuous covariates at their means (0 on the z scale), categorical
      # covariates at their reference level (Edge type = Cut Bank, water body =
      # Distributary)".  Using the modal level here instead made panels disagree:
      # e.g. EDSM dox_z conditioned on Distributary while the other EDSM panels
      # conditioned on Shoal, so absolute predicted heights were not comparable.
      nd[[v]] <- if (is.numeric(col)) {
        mean(col, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else if (is.factor(col)) {
        levels(col)[1L]
      } else {
        sort(unique(as.character(col)))[1L]   # brms sorts character -> factor levels
      }
    }
    nd
  }

  weights <- stacking_weights_streamed(fit_names, fit_paths, criteria, method)

  cand_effects <- unique(sub("^b_", "", as.character(selected_params)))
  cand_norm    <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(cand_effects)

  grids       <- list()
  ce_template <- list()
  pred_names  <- character(0)

  # ---- Pass A: capture one reference grid per effect ----
  for (nm in fit_names) {
    f <- readRDS(fit_paths[[nm]])
    rhs <- tryCatch(f$formula$formula[[3]], error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(rhs)) pred_names <- union(pred_names, all.vars(rhs))
    need <- cand_effects[!cand_effects %in% names(grids)]
    if (length(need) > 0L) {
      ce_f <- tryCatch(
        suppressWarnings(conditional_effects(
          f, effects = need, resolution = resolution, re_formula = re_formula)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (!is.null(ce_f) && length(ce_f) > 0L) {
        ret_norm <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(names(ce_f))
        for (j in seq_along(ce_f)) {
          key <- cand_effects[match(ret_norm[j], cand_norm)]
          if (is.na(key) || key %in% names(grids)) next
          cedf <- ce_f[[j]]
          ce_template[[key]] <- cedf
          nd <- cedf; nd[intersect(names(nd), summ_cols)] <- NULL
          grids[[key]] <- nd
        }
      }
    }
    rm(f); gc(verbose = FALSE)
    if (all(cand_effects %in% names(grids))) break
  }

  effect_names <- cand_effects[cand_effects %in% names(grids)]
  missing_eff  <- setdiff(cand_effects, effect_names)
  if (length(missing_eff) > 0L)
    warning("Effects not found in any model: ", paste(missing_eff, collapse = ", "))
  if (length(effect_names) == 0L)
    stop("No requested effects are available for this survey.")

  # ---- Pass B: weighted ensemble prediction on each grid ----
  acc <- setNames(vector("list", length(effect_names)), effect_names)
  for (nm in fit_names) {
    w <- weights[[nm]]
    if (is.na(w) || w <= 0) next
    f <- readRDS(fit_paths[[nm]])
    pred_names <- union(pred_names, all.vars(f$formula$formula[[3]]))
    for (eff in effect_names) {
      nd   <- build_model_newdata(f, grids[[eff]])
      pred <- epred_fn(f, newdata = nd, re_formula = re_formula)
      acc[[eff]] <- if (is.null(acc[[eff]])) w * pred else acc[[eff]] + w * pred
    }
    rm(f); gc(verbose = FALSE)
  }

  # ---- summarize ----
  ce_list <- list()
  for (eff in effect_names) {
    em <- acc[[eff]]
    lo <- apply(em, 2, quantile, probs[1])
    up <- apply(em, 2, quantile, probs[2])
    mn <- apply(em, 2, median)
    mn <- pmax(lo, pmin(mn, up))
    base_ce <- ce_template[[eff]]
    base_ce[intersect(names(base_ce), summ_cols)] <- NULL
    base_ce$estimate__ <- mn; base_ce$lower__ <- lo; base_ce$upper__ <- up
    ce_list[[eff]] <- base_ce
    message("[stream CE FULLENS] '", eff, "' — grid ", length(mn),
            " pts | est range ", paste(round(range(mn), 5), collapse = " .. "))
  }
  list(ce = ce_list, pred_names = pred_names)
}

# FL/gaussian epred wrapper (no lognormal correction): identical signature to
# epred_marginal_lognormal so it slots into compute_survey_ce's epred_fn.
posterior_epred_plain <- function(object, newdata, re_formula = NA, ...) {
  posterior_epred(object, newdata = newdata, re_formula = re_formula, ...)
}
```

CACHED COMBINED CONDITIONAL-EFFECTS PLOT BUILDER
```{r ccep-cached}
# CACHED combined conditional-effects plot.  Identical layout/back-transform to the
# source combined_cond_effects_plot, but takes the two precomputed per-survey CE
# results (from compute_survey_ce) instead of streaming fits itself.
combined_cond_effects_plot_cached <- function(
  tps_result,
  edsm_result,
  wide_y_params        = NULL,
  narrow_y_params      = NULL,
  param_labels         = NULL,
  y_axis_label         = "Predicted effect on response",
  tps_title            = "TPS",
  edsm_title           = "EDSM",
  main_title           = "Combined conditional effects",
  show_facet_subtitles = FALSE,
  legend_position      = "right",
  interaction_colors   = c("#0072B2", "#E69F00", "#CC79A7"),
  tps_z_stats          = NULL,
  edsm_z_stats         = NULL,
  facet_spec           = NULL
) {
  # Convert user param names (b_ prefix optional) to brms CE effect names
  to_ce_names <- function(params, pred_names) {
    unique(vapply(as.character(params), function(x) {
      eff <- sub("^b_", "", x)
      if (grepl(":", eff, fixed = TRUE)) return(eff)
      if (eff %in% pred_names) return(eff)
      hits <- pred_names[startsWith(eff, pred_names)]
      if (length(hits) > 0L) return(hits[which.max(nchar(hits))])
      eff
    }, character(1)))
  }

  tps_ce   <- tps_result$ce
  edsm_ce  <- edsm_result$ce
  all_pred <- union(tps_result$pred_names, edsm_result$pred_names)

  # ── y-axis group classification ───────────────────────────────────────────
  # normalize_effect_interaction_names is defined earlier in this notebook
  wide_norm <- if (!is.null(wide_y_params))
    normalize_effect_interaction_names(to_ce_names(wide_y_params, all_pred)) else character(0)

  narrow_norm <- if (!is.null(narrow_y_params))
    normalize_effect_interaction_names(to_ce_names(narrow_y_params, all_pred)) else NULL

  classify_eff <- function(eff) {
    en <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(eff)
    if (en %in% wide_norm) return("wide")
    if (!is.null(narrow_norm) && en %in% narrow_norm) return("narrow")
    if (is.null(narrow_norm)) return("narrow")  # NULL = all remaining are narrow
    "free"
  }

  # y-limits derived from both surveys' CE data for a given group
  get_ylim_for_group <- function(group) {
    dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), c(
      lapply(names(tps_ce),  function(n) if (classify_eff(n) == group) tps_ce[[n]]  else NULL),
      lapply(names(edsm_ce), function(n) if (classify_eff(n) == group) edsm_ce[[n]] else NULL)
    ))
    if (length(dfs) == 0L) return(NULL)
    range(unlist(lapply(dfs, function(df) c(df$lower__, df$upper__))), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  y_lim_wide   <- get_ylim_for_group("wide")
  y_lim_narrow <- get_ylim_for_group("narrow")

  # ── x-axis label lookup: convert param_labels keys to CE names ────────────
  x_labels_ce <- param_labels
  if (!is.null(x_labels_ce) && !is.null(names(x_labels_ce))) {
    names(x_labels_ce) <- vapply(names(x_labels_ce),
                                 function(k) to_ce_names(k, all_pred),
                                 character(1))
  }

  # ── build individual effect plots ─────────────────────────────────────────
  # z_stats: named list variable -> list(mean, sd, digits) for back-transform.
  # NULL means keep z-score axis as-is.
  make_plots <- function(ce_list, z_stats = NULL) {
    lapply(names(ce_list), function(eff) {
      ylim <- switch(classify_eff(eff),
        wide   = y_lim_wide,
        narrow = y_lim_narrow,
        NULL
      )

      ce_data        <- ce_list[[eff]]
      is_interaction <- "effect2__" %in% names(ce_data)
      is_categorical <- is.factor(ce_data$effect1__)

      # For interaction plots the x-axis label should name the swept variable
      # (effect1__), not the full interaction term.  Look up the first variable's
      # label and override the entry keyed by the full interaction name.
      x_labels_here <- x_labels_ce
      first_term <- strsplit(eff, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]][1]
      if (is_interaction && !is.null(x_labels_ce)) {
        first_term_label <- get_effect_option(x_labels_ce, first_term)
        if (!is.null(first_term_label)) {
          x_labels_here        <- as.list(x_labels_ce)
          x_labels_here[[eff]] <- first_term_label
        }
      }

      # Legend title and value labels for interaction plots.
      # When z_stats contains out30_z, back-transform the legend breaks to
      # original outflow units (cms; out30_z stats are pre-scaled to cms).
      out30_stats <- z_stats[["out30_z"]]
      if (is_interaction) {
        leg_title <- if (!is.null(out30_stats)) "Outflow (cms)" else "Outflow (z-score)"
        leg_labels <- if (!is.null(out30_stats)) {
          function(breaks) {
            orig <- as.numeric(breaks) * out30_stats$sd + out30_stats$mean
            format(round(orig, -1), big.mark = ",")
          }
        } else {
          function(breaks) paste0("z = ", round(as.numeric(breaks), 2))
        }
      } else {
        leg_title  <- NULL
        leg_labels <- NULL
      }

      p <- plot_ce_effect(
        effect_data         = ce_data,
        effect_name         = eff,
        x_axis_labels       = x_labels_here,
        y_axis_label        = y_axis_label,
        legend_title        = leg_title,
        legend_labels       = leg_labels,
        show_facet_subtitle = show_facet_subtitles,
        y_limits            = ylim,
        legend_position     = legend_position,
        interaction_colors  = interaction_colors
      )

      # Back-transform continuous x-axis tick labels to original scale.
      # Uses the first variable's stats (for interactions, the swept variable).
      if (!is.null(z_stats) && !is_categorical) {
        eff_stats <- z_stats[[first_term]]
        if (!is.null(eff_stats)) {
          p <- p + scale_x_continuous(
            labels = function(z_val) {
              orig <- z_val * eff_stats$sd + eff_stats$mean
              format(round(orig, eff_stats$digits),
                     big.mark = ",",
                     nsmall   = max(0L, eff_stats$digits))
            }
          )
        }
      }

      # Global axis typography: suppress per-facet y-axis title (replaced below by
      # a single shared label), set x-axis title to 10 pt, tick labels to 8 pt.
      p <- p + theme(
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9),
        axis.text    = element_text(size = 8)
      )

      # Angle x-axis tick labels for categorical effects (Edge_Type, habitat2020)
      if (is_categorical) {
        p <- p + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 20, hjust = 1))
      }

      # Move interaction legend inside plot at top-left to free up horizontal space
      if (is_interaction) {
        p <- p + theme(
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.position      = c(0, 1.1),
          legend.justification = c(0, 1),
          legend.background    = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.5), color = NA),
          legend.key.size      = unit(0.3, "cm")
        )
      }

      p
    })
  }

  tps_plots  <- make_plots(tps_ce,  z_stats = tps_z_stats)
  edsm_plots <- make_plots(edsm_ce, z_stats = edsm_z_stats)

  # ── two-column patchwork assembly ─────────────────────────────────────────
  # Build ONE unified n_max×2 grid so every row gets equal height.
  # When facet_spec is provided, rows are placed by explicit row number so
  # loner covariates from different surveys align in the same grid row; a
  # spacer is inserted wherever a survey has no entry for a given row.
  # Without facet_spec, falls back to positional interleaving.

  # Named plot lookup by (normalized) CE effect name
  tps_plot_map  <- setNames(tps_plots,  names(tps_ce))
  edsm_plot_map <- setNames(edsm_plots, names(edsm_ce))

  lookup_plot <- function(cov, plot_map) {
    ce_raw  <- to_ce_names(cov, all_pred)
    ce_norm <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(ce_raw)
    map_norm <- normalize_effect_interaction_names(names(plot_map))
    idx <- which(map_norm == ce_norm)
    if (length(idx) == 0L) patchwork::plot_spacer() else plot_map[[idx[1L]]]
  }

  attach_col_title <- function(p, title_text) {
    p + ggplot2::labs(title = title_text) +
      ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size = 10, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 4)))
  }

  if (!is.null(facet_spec)) {
    all_rows   <- sort(unique(facet_spec$row))
    n_max      <- length(all_rows)
    tps_rows   <- facet_spec[facet_spec$survey == "tps",  ]
    edsm_rows  <- facet_spec[facet_spec$survey == "edsm", ]

    tps_first_row  <- if (nrow(tps_rows)  > 0L) min(tps_rows$row)  else Inf
    edsm_first_row <- if (nrow(edsm_rows) > 0L) min(edsm_rows$row) else Inf

    all_plots <- vector("list", 2L * n_max)
    for (i in seq_along(all_rows)) {
      r  <- all_rows[i]
      te <- tps_rows[tps_rows$row   == r, ]
      ee <- edsm_rows[edsm_rows$row == r, ]

      tps_p  <- if (nrow(te) > 0L) lookup_plot(te$covariate[1L],  tps_plot_map)  else patchwork::plot_spacer()
      edsm_p <- if (nrow(ee) > 0L) lookup_plot(ee$covariate[1L],  edsm_plot_map) else patchwork::plot_spacer()

      if (r == tps_first_row  && !is.null(tps_title)  && nzchar(as.character(tps_title)))
        tps_p  <- attach_col_title(tps_p,  tps_title)
      if (r == edsm_first_row && !is.null(edsm_title) && nzchar(as.character(edsm_title)))
        edsm_p <- attach_col_title(edsm_p, edsm_title)

      all_plots[[2L * i - 1L]] <- tps_p
      all_plots[[2L * i]]      <- edsm_p
    }
  } else {
    # Positional fallback (no facet_spec)
    n_tps  <- length(tps_plots)
    n_edsm <- length(edsm_plots)
    n_max  <- max(n_tps, n_edsm)

    if (n_tps  < n_max)
      tps_plots  <- c(tps_plots,  rep(list(patchwork::plot_spacer()), n_max - n_tps))
    if (n_edsm < n_max)
      edsm_plots <- c(edsm_plots, rep(list(patchwork::plot_spacer()), n_max - n_edsm))

    if (!is.null(tps_title) && nzchar(as.character(tps_title)))
      tps_plots[[1]] <- attach_col_title(tps_plots[[1]], tps_title)
    if (!is.null(edsm_title) && nzchar(as.character(edsm_title)))
      edsm_plots[[1]] <- attach_col_title(edsm_plots[[1]], edsm_title)

    all_plots <- vector("list", 2L * n_max)
    for (i in seq_len(n_max)) {
      all_plots[[2L * i - 1L]] <- tps_plots[[i]]
      all_plots[[2L * i]]      <- edsm_plots[[i]]
    }
  }

  # guides = "keep" so interaction plots retain their inside-positioned legends
  grid_panel <- patchwork::wrap_plots(all_plots, ncol = 2L, byrow = TRUE,
                                      guides = "keep")

  # Shared rotated y-axis title spanning the full figure height.
  # wrap_elements() lets a raw grid grob participate in patchwork layout.
  y_grob <- grid::textGrob(
    y_axis_label,
    rot  = 90,
    gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10)
  )

  patchwork::wrap_elements(y_grob) + grid_panel +
    patchwork::plot_layout(widths = c(0.03, 0.97))
}
```

CACHED FORK-LENGTH CONDITIONAL-EFFECTS PLOT BUILDER
```{r fl-ce-cached}
# CACHED fork-length ensemble conditional-effects plot.  The layout half of the
# source ensemble_conditional_effects_stacking_fl(): takes the precomputed
# ensemble CE list (named effect -> CE df, from compute_survey_ce) and assembles
# the faceted figure.  Keeps the freed-y-axis behaviour: effects named in
# free_y_effects get their own y-axis; the rest share one range computed from the
# coupled facets only.
plot_fl_ensemble_ce_cached <- function(
  ensemble_ce_list,
  preferred_order      = NULL,
  ncol = 1, nrow = NULL,
  main_title           = "TPS fork length: model-averaged conditional effects",
  x_axis_labels        = NULL,
  y_axis_label         = "Predicted ForkLength (mm)",
  show_facet_subtitles = FALSE,
  fixed_y_scale        = TRUE,
  free_y_effects       = NULL,
  ce_color             = "#0072B2",
  z_stats              = NULL
) {
  effect_names <- names(ensemble_ce_list)
  if (!is.null(preferred_order)) {
    effect_names <- c(preferred_order[preferred_order %in% effect_names],
                      setdiff(effect_names, preferred_order))
  }
  ensemble_ce_list <- ensemble_ce_list[effect_names]

  y_limits <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(fixed_y_scale)) {
    # Shared y-range from the coupled facets only; free_y_effects are excluded so
    # they don't stretch the common scale.
    shared_effects <- setdiff(names(ensemble_ce_list), free_y_effects)
    y_limits <- range(unlist(lapply(ensemble_ce_list[shared_effects],
                                    function(df) c(df$lower__, df$upper__))), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  plot_list <- list()
  for (eff in names(ensemble_ce_list)) {
    eff_y_limits <- if (eff %in% free_y_effects) NULL else y_limits
    plot_list[[eff]] <- plot_ce_effect_fl(
      effect_data = ensemble_ce_list[[eff]], effect_name = eff,
      x_axis_labels = x_axis_labels, y_axis_label = y_axis_label,
      show_facet_subtitle = show_facet_subtitles, y_limits = eff_y_limits, ce_color = ce_color,
      z_stats = z_stats
    )
  }

  wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = ncol, nrow = nrow) +
    plot_annotation(title = main_title)
}
```

FORK-LENGTH BETA FOREST FUNCTION (verbatim)
```{r fl-forest-fn}
tps_fl_cluster_forest <- function(
  fit_names, fit_paths,
  criteria              = NULL,        # precomputed kfold criteria (skip disk re-read)
  draws_cache           = NULL,        # name -> b_* draws df (skip fit loading)
  patterns_to_exclude   = character(0),
  include_regex         = "^b_",
  preferred_param_order = NULL,
  param_labels          = NULL,
  declutter_threshold   = 0.95,
  label_mode            = c("centered", "right"),
  fill_color            = "#0072B2",
  title                 = NULL,
  x_axis_label          = "Posterior beta estimate (z-score)",
  x_limits              = NULL,
  slab_n                = 128L,
  band_gap              = 0.4,
  annot_size            = 3.2,
  annot_angle           = 45,
  # ── "centered" mode knobs ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  slab_scale            = 1.2,   # slab peak height (band units)
  annot_base_gap        = 0.15,  # gap from slab top (centered) / baseline (right) to first label
  annot_height          = 2.0,   # vertical room reserved for the angled labels (band units)
  annot_x_gap           = 0.6,   # horizontal spacing between centered labels (x data units = mm)
  annot_shift           = 0.5,   # push centered labels further above their slab (band units)
  annot_hjust           = 0,
  # ── "right" mode knobs (ALT2 layout: 45-degree labels march RIGHT from an absolute anchor) ──
  band_half             = 1.7,   # row upward-extent (band units); sets row spacing ALONE
                                 #   (decoupled from slab_scale and the annotation knobs)
  annot_x               = NULL,  # absolute LEFT x where every row's label set begins (all rows align here);
                                 #   NULL = auto (right side of the panel, sized so the longest row fits)
  annot_y               = 0.35,  # label distance ABOVE the baseline (band units; 0 = on the line)
                                 #   (reuses annot_x_gap for the in-cluster rightward spacing)
  method                = "stacking"
) {
  label_mode <- match.arg(label_mode)
  regex_excl <- if (length(patterns_to_exclude) > 0L)
    paste(patterns_to_exclude, collapse = "|") else "XXXXXXXX_NOMATCH"
  load_one <- function(nm)
    if (exists(nm, inherits = TRUE)) get(nm, inherits = TRUE) else readRDS(fit_paths[[nm]])

  # Full-ensemble stacking weights (from criteria only when supplied).
  weights <- stacking_weights_streamed(fit_names, fit_paths, criteria, method)

  # Per-fit b_* draws (prefer the cache; else stream + unload).
  draws_raw <- vector("list", length(fit_names)); names(draws_raw) <- fit_names
  norm_list <- vector("list", length(fit_names)); names(norm_list) <- fit_names
  for (nm in fit_names) {
    df_full <- if (!is.null(draws_cache) && nm %in% names(draws_cache)) {
      draws_cache[[nm]]
    } else {
      f <- load_one(nm); d <- as_draws_df(f); rm(f); gc(verbose = FALSE); d
    }
    df       <- df_full %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches(regex_excl))
    raw_cols <- names(df)[grepl(include_regex, names(df))]
    draws_raw[[nm]] <- df[, raw_cols, drop = FALSE]
    norm_list[[nm]] <- setNames(normalize_beta_interaction_param(raw_cols), raw_cols)
  }

  all_norm_params <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(norm_list, unname))))
  if (!is.null(preferred_param_order)) {
    all_norm_params <- c(preferred_param_order[preferred_param_order %in% all_norm_params],
                         setdiff(all_norm_params, preferred_param_order))
  }

  # Per-covariate declutter: keep top models by renormalized weight up to the
  # cumulative threshold; label uses each model's OVERALL stacking weight.
  fmt_w <- function(w) ifelse(w >= 0.01, sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * w), "<1%")
  row_blocks <- list()
  for (p in all_norm_params) {
    model_idx <- which(vapply(norm_list, function(nv) p %in% nv, logical(1)))
    if (length(model_idx) == 0L) next
    w_raw <- weights[model_idx]; total <- sum(w_raw)
    w_sub <- if (total > 0) w_raw / total else rep(0, length(w_raw))
    ord   <- order(w_sub, decreasing = TRUE)
    model_idx <- model_idx[ord]; w_sub <- w_sub[ord]; w_raw <- w_raw[ord]
    keep_n <- if (total > 0) which(cumsum(w_sub) >= declutter_threshold)[1L] else NA_integer_
    if (is.na(keep_n)) keep_n <- length(w_sub)
    model_idx <- model_idx[seq_len(keep_n)]; w_raw <- w_raw[seq_len(keep_n)]
    for (k in seq_along(model_idx)) {
      i  <- model_idx[k]; nm <- fit_names[i]
      rc <- names(norm_list[[i]])[norm_list[[i]] == p][1L]
      row_blocks[[length(row_blocks) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        param = p, fit_name = nm,
        model_num = sub(".*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", nm),
        overall_weight = w_raw[k],
        estimate = draws_raw[[i]][[rc]],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  if (length(row_blocks) == 0L) stop("No covariates with contributing models found.")
  plot_df <- bind_rows(row_blocks)

  ordered_present <- all_norm_params[all_norm_params %in% unique(plot_df$param)]
  K <- length(ordered_present)
  param_label_lookup <- setNames(
    map_parameter_labels(ordered_present, param_labels, lookup_keys = ordered_present),
    ordered_present
  )

  # ── Annotation table + vertical budget (per label_mode) ─────────────────────
  if (label_mode == "centered") {
    annot <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(param, fit_name, model_num, overall_weight) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(median_x = median(estimate), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(param) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(median_x, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        n_mod      = dplyr::n(),
        center     = mean(median_x),
        label_x    = center + (dplyr::row_number() - (n_mod + 1) / 2) * annot_x_gap,
        label_text = paste0(model_num, " (", fmt_w(overall_weight), ")")
      ) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
    up_extent <- slab_scale + annot_base_gap + annot_shift + annot_height
  } else {
    # ALT2 layout: one angled label per model, in median order, that LEFT-aligns at
    # an absolute x and marches RIGHTWARD by annot_x_gap.  Every covariate's set lines
    # up on its left edge, independent of slab position; y is set directly off the
    # baseline (annot_y) below, so the labels sit low, over the band baselines.
    annot <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(param, fit_name, model_num, overall_weight) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(median_x = median(estimate), .groups = "drop") %>%
      dplyr::group_by(param) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(median_x, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        march      = (dplyr::row_number() - 1) * annot_x_gap,   # rightward offset from the anchor
        label_text = paste0(model_num, " (", fmt_w(overall_weight), ")")
      ) %>% dplyr::ungroup()
    up_extent <- band_half          # row height set by band_half ALONE; slab_scale stays absolute
  }

  row_spacing <- up_extent + band_gap
  pos <- setNames((K - seq_len(K)) * row_spacing, ordered_present)   # first param on top
  plot_df$baseline <- pos[plot_df$param]
  annot$baseline   <- pos[annot$param]

  # ── Manual density slabs, all rising UP from baseline, GLOBAL equal-area ─────
  slab_polys <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(param, fit_name, baseline) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      d <- density(.x$estimate, n = slab_n, cut = 0)
      data.frame(x = d$x, dens = d$y)
    }) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(height = dens / max(dens) * slab_scale)
  slab_polys$grp <- paste(slab_polys$fit_name, slab_polys$param, sep = "__")

  slab_top <- slab_polys %>% dplyr::group_by(param) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(slab_top = max(height), .groups = "drop")

  curve_df <- slab_polys %>% dplyr::mutate(y = baseline + height)
  poly_df  <- curve_df %>% dplyr::group_by(grp, param) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~ rbind(
      data.frame(x = .x$x,      y = .x$y),
      data.frame(x = rev(.x$x), y = rev(.x$baseline))
    )) %>% dplyr::ungroup()

  # ── Shared limits ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  y_lim <- c(min(pos) - band_gap / 2, max(pos) + up_extent + band_gap / 2)
  xq    <- quantile(plot_df$estimate, probs = c(0.005, 0.995), na.rm = TRUE)
  x_lim <- if (!is.null(x_limits)) x_limits else c(floor(xq[1]), ceiling(xq[2]))

  # ── Label anchor y (and x for right mode) ───────────────────────────────────
  if (label_mode == "centered") {
    annot <- dplyr::left_join(annot, slab_top, by = "param")
    annot$slab_top[is.na(annot$slab_top)] <- 0
    annot$label_y <- annot$baseline + annot$slab_top + annot_base_gap + annot_shift
  } else {
    # Left edge of the label block: the same absolute x for every row.  Auto-default
    # places it so the LONGEST row's labels finish just inside the right edge.
    max_march <- max(annot$march)
    anchor_x  <- if (!is.null(annot_x)) annot_x else x_lim[2] - max_march - 0.3
    annot$label_x <- anchor_x + annot$march
    annot$label_y <- annot$baseline + annot_y
  }

  right_pad <- if (label_mode == "right") 40 else 5.5

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = pos, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    geom_polygon(data = poly_df, aes(x = x, y = y, group = grp),
                 fill = fill_color, color = NA, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_path(data = curve_df, aes(x = x, y = y, group = grp),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_point(data = annot, aes(x = median_x, y = baseline),
               color = fill_color, size = 2.3, shape = 16) +
    geom_text(data = annot, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = label_text),
              angle = annot_angle, size = annot_size,
              hjust = annot_hjust, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey20") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim, xlim = x_lim, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = x_axis_label) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = pos, labels = param_label_lookup[ordered_present], name = NULL) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 10, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = margin(5.5, right_pad, 5.5, 5.5)
    )
}

```

BUTTERFLY-STYLE FORK-LENGTH FOREST — ALT90 (90-degree annotations, E&C single column)
Right-march layout adapted to match the butterfly ALT4/ALT5 styling: 90-degree vertical
annotations with "%"/space stripped, black median hash marks, wrapped covariate labels,
Helvetica 8-9 pt lettering, 84 mm width, and axis spacing / curve heights tuned to the
butterfly for continuity.  The image HEIGHT is dictated by the number of covariate axes
(returned as attr(p, "fig_height_in")), not clamped to the E&C max height.
```{r fl-forest-alt90-fn}
tps_fl_cluster_forest_alt90 <- function(
  fit_names, fit_paths,
  criteria              = NULL,
  draws_cache           = NULL,
  patterns_to_exclude   = character(0),
  include_regex         = "^b_",
  preferred_param_order = NULL,
  param_labels          = NULL,
  declutter_threshold   = 0.95,
  min_weight            = 0.01,        # drop models with overall stacking weight < this (butterfly parity)
  fill_color            = "#0072B2",
  slab_alpha            = 0.4,
  title                 = NULL,
  x_axis_label          = "Posterior beta estimate (mm change in ForkLength)",
  x_limits              = NULL,
  slab_n                = 128L,
  # ── geometry (butterfly-continuity defaults) ──────────────────────────────
  band_half             = 3.0,         # row up-extent; row_spacing = band_half + band_gap
                                       #   (3.0 + 0.4 = 3.4 matches the butterfly axis spacing)
  band_gap              = 0.4,
  slab_scale            = 1.5,         # curve peak height (band units); matches the butterfly
  outer_pad_frac_top    = 0.8,         # top margin as a fraction of row_spacing (extra room for
                                       #   the vertical 90-degree labels)
  outer_pad_frac_bottom = 0.55,        # bottom margin as a fraction of row_spacing
  # ── median hash (black, like the butterfly) ───────────────────────────────
  median_tick_len       = 0.6,         # tick length (band units), rising INTO the slab
  median_tick_color     = "black",
  median_tick_lw        = 0.6,
  # ── annotations (90-degree, marching RIGHT from an absolute anchor) ────────
  annot_angle           = 90,
  annot_size            = 2.85,        # geom_text size in mm; 2.85 mm ~= 8.1 pt
  annot_x_gap           = 0.25,        # in-cluster spacing between stacked labels (x data units)
  annot_x               = NULL,        # absolute LEFT x anchor of every row's label set; NULL = auto
  annot_y               = 0.35,        # label offset ABOVE the baseline (band units)
  annot_hjust           = 0,
  annot_vjust           = 0.5,
  # ── fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  base_family           = "Helvetica",
  axis_text_y_size      = 8.5,
  axis_text_x_size      = 8,
  axis_title_size       = 9,
  # ── image height auto-sizing (dictated by the axes) ───────────────────────
  band_unit_in          = 0.178,       # physical inches per band unit (butterfly continuity)
  axis_extra_in         = 0.9,         # fixed inches for the x-axis title/labels + margins
  method                = "stacking"
) {
  regex_excl <- if (length(patterns_to_exclude) > 0L)
    paste(patterns_to_exclude, collapse = "|") else "XXXXXXXX_NOMATCH"
  load_one <- function(nm)
    if (exists(nm, inherits = TRUE)) get(nm, inherits = TRUE) else readRDS(fit_paths[[nm]])

  weights <- stacking_weights_streamed(fit_names, fit_paths, criteria, method)

  draws_raw <- vector("list", length(fit_names)); names(draws_raw) <- fit_names
  norm_list <- vector("list", length(fit_names)); names(norm_list) <- fit_names
  for (nm in fit_names) {
    df_full <- if (!is.null(draws_cache) && nm %in% names(draws_cache)) {
      draws_cache[[nm]]
    } else {
      f <- load_one(nm); d <- as_draws_df(f); rm(f); gc(verbose = FALSE); d
    }
    df       <- df_full %>% dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches(regex_excl))
    raw_cols <- names(df)[grepl(include_regex, names(df))]
    draws_raw[[nm]] <- df[, raw_cols, drop = FALSE]
    norm_list[[nm]] <- setNames(normalize_beta_interaction_param(raw_cols), raw_cols)
  }

  all_norm_params <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(norm_list, unname))))
  if (!is.null(preferred_param_order)) {
    all_norm_params <- c(preferred_param_order[preferred_param_order %in% all_norm_params],
                         setdiff(all_norm_params, preferred_param_order))
  }

  # % stripped; no space before the "(" — matches the butterfly annotations.
  fmt_w <- function(w) ifelse(w >= 0.01, sprintf("%.0f", 100 * w), "<1")
  row_blocks <- list()
  for (p in all_norm_params) {
    model_idx <- which(vapply(norm_list, function(nv) p %in% nv, logical(1)))
    if (length(model_idx) == 0L) next
    w_raw <- weights[model_idx]; total <- sum(w_raw)
    w_sub <- if (total > 0) w_raw / total else rep(0, length(w_raw))
    ord   <- order(w_sub, decreasing = TRUE)
    model_idx <- model_idx[ord]; w_sub <- w_sub[ord]; w_raw <- w_raw[ord]
    keep_n <- if (total > 0) which(cumsum(w_sub) >= declutter_threshold)[1L] else NA_integer_
    if (is.na(keep_n)) keep_n <- length(w_sub)
    model_idx <- model_idx[seq_len(keep_n)]; w_raw <- w_raw[seq_len(keep_n)]
    keep_mw   <- w_raw >= min_weight                 # drop <1% models
    model_idx <- model_idx[keep_mw]; w_raw <- w_raw[keep_mw]
    for (k in seq_along(model_idx)) {
      i  <- model_idx[k]; nm <- fit_names[i]
      rc <- names(norm_list[[i]])[norm_list[[i]] == p][1L]
      row_blocks[[length(row_blocks) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        param = p, fit_name = nm,
        model_num = sub(".*?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", nm),
        overall_weight = w_raw[k],
        estimate = draws_raw[[i]][[rc]],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  if (length(row_blocks) == 0L) stop("No covariates with contributing models found.")
  plot_df <- bind_rows(row_blocks)

  ordered_present <- all_norm_params[all_norm_params %in% unique(plot_df$param)]
  K <- length(ordered_present)
  param_label_lookup <- setNames(
    map_parameter_labels(ordered_present, param_labels, lookup_keys = ordered_present),
    ordered_present
  )

  # One label per model, in median order, marching RIGHT from an absolute anchor.
  annot <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(param, fit_name, model_num, overall_weight) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(median_x = median(estimate), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(param) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_x, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      march      = (dplyr::row_number() - 1) * annot_x_gap,
      label_text = paste0(model_num, "(", fmt_w(overall_weight), ")")
    ) %>% dplyr::ungroup()

  up_extent   <- band_half
  row_spacing <- up_extent + band_gap
  pos <- setNames((K - seq_len(K)) * row_spacing, ordered_present)   # first param on top
  plot_df$baseline <- pos[plot_df$param]
  annot$baseline   <- pos[annot$param]

  # Density slabs, all rising UP from the baseline (single survey).
  slab_polys <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(param, fit_name, baseline) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      d <- density(.x$estimate, n = slab_n, cut = 0)
      data.frame(x = d$x, dens = d$y)
    }) %>% dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(height = dens / max(dens) * slab_scale)
  slab_polys$grp <- paste(slab_polys$fit_name, slab_polys$param, sep = "__")

  curve_df <- slab_polys %>% dplyr::mutate(y = baseline + height)
  poly_df  <- curve_df %>% dplyr::group_by(grp, param) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~ rbind(
      data.frame(x = .x$x,      y = .x$y),
      data.frame(x = rev(.x$x), y = rev(.x$baseline))
    )) %>% dplyr::ungroup()

  y_lim <- c(min(pos) - row_spacing * outer_pad_frac_bottom,
             max(pos) + row_spacing * outer_pad_frac_top)
  xq    <- quantile(plot_df$estimate, probs = c(0.005, 0.995), na.rm = TRUE)
  x_lim <- if (!is.null(x_limits)) x_limits else c(floor(xq[1]), ceiling(xq[2]))

  # Absolute LEFT x of every row's label set.  Auto default lands the LONGEST stack
  # just inside the right edge; set annot_x to push it further right by hand.
  max_march <- max(annot$march)
  anchor_x  <- if (!is.null(annot_x)) annot_x else x_lim[2] - max_march - 0.3
  annot$label_x <- anchor_x + annot$march
  annot$label_y <- annot$baseline + annot_y

  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = pos, color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
    geom_polygon(data = poly_df, aes(x = x, y = y, group = grp),
                 fill = fill_color, color = NA, alpha = slab_alpha) +
    geom_path(data = curve_df, aes(x = x, y = y, group = grp),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_segment(data = annot,
                 aes(x = median_x, xend = median_x,
                     y = baseline, yend = baseline + median_tick_len),
                 color = median_tick_color, linewidth = median_tick_lw, lineend = "round") +
    geom_text(data = annot, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = label_text),
              angle = annot_angle, size = annot_size, family = base_family,
              hjust = annot_hjust, vjust = annot_vjust, color = "grey20") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim, xlim = x_lim, clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = x_axis_label) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = pos, labels = param_label_lookup[ordered_present],
                       name = NULL, expand = expansion(mult = 0)) +
    labs(title = title) +
    marquee::marquefy_theme(theme_minimal(base_family = base_family)) +
    theme(
      # marquee renders **bold**.  It ONLY works because marquefy_theme() above also
      # marquee-ises the root text element — ggplot2 4.x element inheritance would
      # otherwise strip the subclass and print the ** literally (as ggtext does).
      # NOTE: line-centring is NOT done here — marquee ignores both `align` and
      # `hjust` for the lines inside a block.  It is baked into the label strings
      # by center_md_lines() in the inputs chunk.
      axis.text.y        = marquee::element_marquee(size = axis_text_y_size, angle = 30,
                                                    hjust = 1, lineheight = 1.05),
      # Must be element_marquee too: with a marquee ROOT text element, a plain
      # element_text child is PROMOTED to marquee and loses its size, so the x tick
      # labels render enormous (the giant "-2024" / "0" bug).
      axis.text.x        = marquee::element_marquee(size = axis_text_x_size),
      axis.title.x       = marquee::element_marquee(size = axis_title_size),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
    )

  # Image height dictated by the covariate axes (not the E&C max height).
  attr(p, "fig_height_in") <- as.numeric(diff(y_lim)) * band_unit_in + axis_extra_in
  p
}
```

FACET SPEC + COMBINED CONDITIONAL-EFFECTS INPUTS (verbatim)
```{r facet-cond-inputs}
facet_spec <- tribble(
  ~row, ~survey,  ~covariate,
  # ── Outflow main effect (shared, row 1) ───────────────────────────────────
  1L,   "tps",    "b_out30_z",
  1L,   "edsm",   "b_out30_z",
  # ── Distance downstream ── TPS: main only; EDSM: interaction replaces main ─
  3L,   "tps",    "b_distance_along_channel_z",
  3L,   "edsm",   "b_distance_along_channel_z:out30_z",
  # ── Distance off mainstem ── both surveys: interaction replaces main ───────
  4L,   "tps",    "b_distance_m_z:out30_z",
  4L,   "edsm",   "b_distance_m_z:out30_z",
  # ── Secchi depth (shared, row 4) ──────────────────────────────────────────
  2L,   "tps",    "b_secchi_z",
  2L,   "edsm",   "b_secchi_z",
  # ── Water quality loners: Chlorophyll (TPS) ↔ Dissolved oxygen (EDSM) ─────
  5L,   "tps",    "b_chlorophyll_z",
  5L,   "edsm",   "b_dox_z",
  # ── Habitat/edge loners: Edge Type (TPS) ↔ Water Body Type (EDSM) ─────────
  6L,   "tps",    "Edge_Type",
  6L,   "edsm",   "habitat2020"
)

combined_cond_plot_inputs <- list(
  # Derived from facet_spec — do not edit these two lines directly
  tps_selected_params  = facet_spec %>% dplyr::filter(survey == "tps")  %>% dplyr::pull(covariate),
  edsm_selected_params = facet_spec %>% dplyr::filter(survey == "edsm") %>% dplyr::pull(covariate),
  facet_spec           = facet_spec,

  # Y-axis group 1 — "wide": shared y range across both surveys, scaled to
  # the largest effect in this group.  Use the same naming style as above.
  wide_y_params = c(
    "b_out30_z"
#    "b_secchi_z"
#    "Edge_Type"
#    "habitat2020"
  ),

  # Y-axis group 2 — "narrow": all remaining parameters.
  # NULL = every parameter not listed in wide_y_params shares the narrower range.
  # Provide an explicit character vector to restrict; any parameter in neither
  # group is plotted with a free (unconstrained) y-axis.
  narrow_y_params = NULL,

  # X-axis labels (b_ prefix and reversed interaction order both accepted)
  param_labels = c(
    "b_out30_z"                  = "30-day outflow (z-score)",
    "b_secchi_z"                 = "Secchi depth (z-score)",
    "b_distance_along_channel_z" = "Distance downstream (z-score)",
    "b_distance_along_channel_z:out30_z" = "Distance downstream × Outflow",
    "b_distance_m_z"             = "Distance off mainstem (z-score)",
    "b_distance_m_z:out30_z"     = "Distance off mainstem × Outflow",
    "b_chlorophyll_z"            = "Chlorophyll-a (z-score)",
    "b_dox_z"                    = "Dissolved oxygen (z-score)",
    "b_start_depth_z"            = "Water Depth (z-score)",
    "Edge_Type"                  = "Edge Type",
    "habitat2020"                = "Water Body Type",
    "b_water_year_day_z"         = "Water year day (z-score)"
  ),
  y_axis_label = "Predicted CPUE",

  # Titles
  tps_title  = "TPS",
  edsm_title = "EDSM",
  main_title = "TPS vs EDSM: ensemble conditional effects",

  # Appearance
  show_facet_subtitles = FALSE,
  legend_position      = "right",

  # Stacking / CE settings
  method     = "stacking",
  re_formula = NA,
  resolution = 100,
  probs      = c(0.05, 0.95),

  # Save output
  output_file   = "output_figs/combined_TPS_EDSM_conditional_effects_kfold",  # no extension — pdf and tiff saved below
  output_width  = 6.5,

)
```

```{r fl-cond-inputs}
cond_model_inputs_fl <- list(
  fit_names           = fit_names_tps_fl,
  method              = "stacking",
  patterns_to_exclude = fl_patterns_to_exclude,
  include_regex       = "^b_",
  resolution          = 100,

)
```

FORK-LENGTH ORIGINAL-SCALE INPUTS (verbatim; cms + meters back-transforms)
```{r fl-origscale-inputs}
fl_recover_zstats <- function(d, orig_col, z_col, digits) {
  cf <- coef(lm(d[[orig_col]] ~ d[[z_col]]))     # original = sd * z + mean  (R^2 = 1)
  list(mean = unname(cf[1]), sd = unname(cf[2]), digits = digits)
}
fl_origscale_data <- read.csv("data/tps_forklength_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# digits: negative = round to a power of 10 (e.g. -3 = nearest 1,000); positive = decimals.
fl_z_stats_origscale <- list(
  # Outflow back-transformed to cms (1 cfs = 0.0283168 cms): scale the recovered mean/sd.
  out30_z                  = local({
    s <- fl_recover_zstats(fl_origscale_data, "OUT_Moving_Mean_30d", "out30_z", -1)
    s$mean <- s$mean * 0.0283168
    s$sd   <- s$sd   * 0.0283168
    s
  }),
  # Water depth back-transformed to meters (1 ft = 0.3048 m): scale the recovered mean/sd.
  start_depth_z            = local({
    s <- fl_recover_zstats(fl_origscale_data, "Start_Depth", "start_depth_z", 1)
    s$mean <- s$mean * 0.3048
    s$sd   <- s$sd   * 0.3048
    s
  }),
  distance_along_channel_z = fl_recover_zstats(fl_origscale_data, "DistanceAlongChannel", "distance_along_channel_z", -3),
  distance_m_z             = fl_recover_zstats(fl_origscale_data, "Distance_m",           "distance_m_z",             -3),
  water_year_day_z         = fl_recover_zstats(fl_origscale_data, "water_year_day",       "water_year_day_z",          0)
)

# Inherit every setting from the z-score inputs; override only the axis titles (units),
# the main title, and the output path.
cond_plot_inputs_fl_origscale <- modifyList(cond_plot_inputs_fl, list(
  param_labels = c(
    "b_out30_z"                  = "30-day outflow (cms)",
    "b_start_depth_z"            = "Water depth (m)",
    "b_distance_along_channel_z" = "Distance downstream (m)",
    "b_distance_m_z"             = "Distance off mainstem (m)",
    "b_water_year_day_z"         = "Water year day",
    "Edge_Type"                  = "Edge Type"
  ),
  main_title  = "TPS fork length: model-averaged conditional effects (K-fold ensemble, original-scale x)",
  output_file = "output_figs/TPS_FL_ensemble_conditional_effects_origscale_kfold"
))
```

GUARDED EXTRACTION — build the cache once, else load it
```{r build-or-load-cache}
if (force_rebuild || !file.exists(cache_path)) {
  message("Building figure cache — streaming every fit once (this is the slow step) ...")

  # 1) b_* draws + predictive criteria, ONE streaming pass per fit (never all resident).
  catch_be <- extract_beta_and_criterion(c(fit_names_tps_catch, fit_names_edsm_catch), fit_paths_all)
  beta_draws_cache   <- catch_be$draws
  tps_criteria_cache <- catch_be$criteria[fit_names_tps_catch]

  fl_be             <- extract_beta_and_criterion(fit_names_tps_fl, fit_paths_tps_fl)
  fl_draws_cache    <- fl_be$draws
  fl_criteria_cache <- fl_be$criteria

  # 2) Precompute ensemble conditional effects (the only fit-touching figure step).
  #    Catch streams via the lognormal epred; fork length via plain posterior_epred.
  cond_catch <- list(
    tps_result  = compute_survey_ce(
      fit_names_tps_catch, fit_paths_all,
      combined_cond_plot_inputs$tps_selected_params, tps_criteria_cache,
      resolution = combined_cond_plot_inputs$resolution,
      re_formula = combined_cond_plot_inputs$re_formula,
      probs      = combined_cond_plot_inputs$probs,
      epred_fn   = epred_marginal_lognormal),
    edsm_result = compute_survey_ce(
      fit_names_edsm_catch, fit_paths_all,
      combined_cond_plot_inputs$edsm_selected_params, edsm_criteria,
      resolution = combined_cond_plot_inputs$resolution,
      re_formula = combined_cond_plot_inputs$re_formula,
      probs      = combined_cond_plot_inputs$probs,
      epred_fn   = epred_marginal_lognormal)
  )

  cond_fl <- list(
    ce_list = compute_survey_ce(
      fit_names_tps_fl, fit_paths_tps_fl,
      cond_plot_inputs_fl$selected_params_cond, fl_criteria_cache,
      resolution = cond_model_inputs_fl$resolution,
      re_formula = cond_model_inputs_fl$re_formula,
      probs      = cond_model_inputs_fl$probs,
      epred_fn   = posterior_epred_plain)$ce
  )

  meta <- list(
    built_at       = Sys.time(),
    catch_selected = list(tps  = combined_cond_plot_inputs$tps_selected_params,
                          edsm = combined_cond_plot_inputs$edsm_selected_params),
    fl_selected    = cond_plot_inputs_fl$selected_params_cond,
    resolution     = combined_cond_plot_inputs$resolution,
    re_formula     = combined_cond_plot_inputs$re_formula,
    probs          = combined_cond_plot_inputs$probs
  )

  figcache <- list(
    beta_draws_cache = beta_draws_cache, tps_criteria_cache = tps_criteria_cache,
    fl_draws_cache = fl_draws_cache, fl_criteria_cache = fl_criteria_cache,
    cond_catch = cond_catch, cond_fl = cond_fl, meta = meta
  )
  dir.create(dirname(cache_path), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  saveRDS(figcache, cache_path)
  message("Figure cache written to ", cache_path)
} else {
  figcache <- readRDS(cache_path)
  message("Loaded figure cache from ", cache_path, " (built ",
          format(figcache$meta$built_at), "). Set force_rebuild <- TRUE to refresh.")
}

# Unpack into the names the figure chunks use.
beta_draws_cache   <- figcache$beta_draws_cache
tps_criteria_cache <- figcache$tps_criteria_cache
fl_draws_cache     <- figcache$fl_draws_cache
fl_criteria_cache  <- figcache$fl_criteria_cache
cond_catch         <- figcache$cond_catch
cond_fl            <- figcache$cond_fl
```
